Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id IS EXACTLY 'CHEMBL1075145', target_dictionary.target_type IS EXACTLY 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.tax_id IS 9606, activities.standard_type IS EXACTLY 'IC50', activities.standard_relation IS EXACTLY '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC. Limit: 1000.
